title: Reading Is Not Using: Retrieval, Judgment, and the Design of AI Financial Research Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.24842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as AI analysts to process financial disclosures and support AI-assisted investment decisions. Yet such systems are usually evaluated by what they can retrieve, not whether retrieved information affects their judgments. We identify a retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis. Holding focal-firm information fixed and varying only unrelated context from 2,000 to 128,000 tokens, we find that a risk disclosure's influence on investment judgments falls to the experimental noise floor even as direct retrieval remains accurate. The pattern replicates across model families and judgment tasks and in experiments removing real disclosures from actual 10-K filings. More capable models postpone but do not eliminate the gap. translated_title: 阅读并非使用：检索、判断与AI金融研究工作流的设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24842v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署为AI分析师，用于处理财务披露并支持AI辅助的投资决策。然而，此类系统通常根据其能检索到的内容来评估，而非检索到的信息是否影响其判断。我们识别出长上下文金融分析中的“检索-整合差距”。在保持焦点公司信息不变、仅将无关上下文从2,000个令牌变化到128,000个令牌的情况下，我们发现风险披露对投资判断的影响降至实验噪声水平，即使直接检索仍保持准确。这一模式在多个模型家族和判断任务中重复出现，并在从实际10-K文件中删除真实披露的实验中得以验证。更强大的模型推迟但并未消除这一差距。因果记忆干预表明，压缩摘要和源文本查找共同将披露传递到判断中。工作流架构决定了……
tldr: 本研究揭示了长上下文金融分析中检索与判断之间的关键差距：即使模型能准确检索信息，其判断也可能不受影响，并强调工作流设计（如压缩摘要与源文本查找的结合）对弥合此差距的重要性。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a critical retrieval-integration gap in long-context financial analysis: even when models can accurately retrieve information, their judgments may remain unaffected, highlighting the importance of workflow architecture in bridging this gap.
